narr: Eastern Pacific Hurricane Hilary made landfall on the Baja Peninsula early on the morning of the 20th and reached Southern California as a tropical storm that afternoon. The cyclone brought major flash flooding and damaging winds to the Spring Mountains, along with less severe flooding elsewhere in southern Nevada.
ev: Severe flash flooding affected the Spring Mountains. Many roads and underground pipes were washed out, several trails and parking areas were damaged or destroyed, and the fire station was damaged. Video showed multiple feet of water flowing down the mountain.
Water covered Highway 95 8 miles WNW of Amargosa Valley.
Eastbound Ute Rd was closed at I-15 due to flooding.
Ranch Rd was closed from Highway 168 to Eiseman St due to flooding.
lsr: Eastbound Ute Road is closed at northbound Interstate 15 due to flooding.
Mount Charleston Fire Chief reported several washed out roads, heavy flows of water, and damage to the Mount Charleston Fire Station due to flooding.
SR-376 washed out at MM62. Highway closed from Carvers to US-50.

Emergency manager reports flooding on Hafen Ranch Road.
Nevada Department of Transportation closed Nevada State Route 157 in both directions at mile marker 12 due to flash flooding.
